To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
a blockchain based decentralized demand response management system can be used to manage the flexibility of distributed prosumers and to match the energy production and demand at smart grid level.

the proposed blockchain-based decentralized demand response management can be used to match energy demand and production in smart grids, the demand response signals being followed with high fidelity, while the amount required of energy flexibility is reduced.

a blockchain based distributed demand response program can be used for balancing the energy supply with the energy demand in a smart grid, the energy demand being adapted in real-time to the actual energy production, with high accuracy, using a small amount of energy flexibility.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the development of a novel approach for decentralized management of Demand Response programs in Smart Energy Grid using blockchain technology.
developing a novel blockchain based distributed ledger for the decentralized management of demand response programs in smart energy grids.
the design of blockchain based smart contracts and consensus protocols for the decentralized management of demand response programs in a smart energy grid.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that

blockchain technology is a promising approach for decentralized demand response management and for providing a secure, reliable, transparent, and timely energy balancing mechanism for smart energy grid applications.

the blockchain based approach is able to achieve a high level of accuracy and convergence speed in the energy demand response management process, while reducing the amount of energy needed for convergence.
the blockchain based distributed demand management is a promising approach to be used in smart grids.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that

blockchain technology is a promising solution for the development of a distributed and secure demand response management system, with a significant potential in reducing energy costs and in improving the energy efficiency of smart grids.

the blockchain based decentralized approach can be used for the efficient management of demand side management programs in smart grids, while the use of consensus based validation can ensure a secure, transparent, and timely management of the energy flexibility markets.
we have proposed a blockchain based decentralized approach for demand response management in smart energy grids.
The main takeaway from our work is that

a decentralized blockchain based approach is a viable option to be considered for the design of demand response programs in smart grids, as it can provide a transparent, secure, and reliable framework to manage demand flexibility at the level each prosumer, and the associated rewards or penalty.
blockchain based distributed ledgers can be used as a reliable, secure, and transparent infrastructure for implementing demand response programs in smart grids.

the use of blockchain based smart contracts for demand side management of smart energy grid can be an effective way for balancing the energy supply and demand, while ensuring the privacy of the prosumer’s information, the reliability and transparency of the energy flexibility programs, and a fair financial settlement for the prosumer’s energy flexibility.
